data.raw_text: JUST IN: Overseas Workers Welfare Administration chief Patricia Yvonne Caunan, in a press briefing in Makati City on Thursday (Nov. 27, 2025), says 19 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) were affected and rescued from the massive fire that razed a housing estate in Hong Kong. She added that that an OFW who went viral after seeking help was also rescued together with her employer. The Department of Migrant Workers, meanwhile, assured assistance for OFWs affected by the fire. | Marita Moaje
